subject.title: feat(agents): derive a provider-declared default utility model when unset

question: Should an unset utilityModel automatically trigger provider-selected utility calls and progress narration for existing OpenAI and Anthropic installations?
rationale: This intentionally changes default cost, content routing, and user-visible behavior; implementation correctness alone cannot decide that policy.

options.title: Adopt automatic defaults
options.body: Accept the new behavior after the transport and config defects are fixed and inspectable fresh-install, upgrade, and live API proof is attached.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve current unset semantics and expose provider defaults only through a separately approved automatic mode.

recommendation.title: Adopt automatic defaults
recommendation.body: Accept the new behavior after the transport and config defects are fixed and inspectable fresh-install, upgrade, and live API proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties this person to the narration feature and the affected provider/config decision surfaces.
